paragraph: The Granville composite prints a neutral 56 out of 100, hard-capped below 60 due to an active breadth divergence where a rising SPY masks a -0.57% contraction in equal-weight participation (RSP/SPY). Under the hood, internal momentum is overwhelmingly top-heavy, driven by booming semiconductor bellwethers (SOXX/SPY at +5.25%) and aggressive risk appetite (SPHB/SPLV at +3.95%), even as credit confidence softens slightly (HYG/LQD at -0.22%). Macro conditions remain generally constructive, characterized by a calm VIX at 16.34 in steep contango and tight high-yield spreads at 2.85%, though rising 10-year real yields at 2.47% threaten broader valuation expansion. Given the stark divergence between roaring tech leadership and weak overall participation, expect a cautiously bullish bias for the session that remains strictly confined to mega-cap momentum.
